name: oh-my-opus
description: Bound an Opus 5 session at its edges without steering how it works: a per-turn subagent cap and an optional end-of-turn recap constrain the boundary, while cheap workers (Haiku scout, Sonnet coder, fresh-context Opus 5 reviewer) stay available by choice and never required. The deliberate inverse of baton — constrain the boundary, never the interior.
